notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Blinking Spirit using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
description:
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Blinking Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
